Definition: from G4314 and G546; to menace additionally:--i. e. threaten further.
BiblicalUsage: Prosapeileo means to threaten further, to add threats to threats. It appears once, when the council, finding nothing to punish Peter and John for, further threatened them and let them go.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that empty threats are the council's confession: they had the power to threaten and nothing else, because the healed man stood right there in front of them.
